notes: The *an* of *an everlasting priesthood* is given to the noun it determines rather than to the adjective standing beside it (rule 15), with עוֹלָם rendered attributively under rule 28.
The anticipatory *it* of *it shall be* is pleonastic and stays with הָיָה (rule 21), since the explicit subject בְּרִית has its own unit later in the verse.
תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר fuses to the single *because*, headed on the governing first morpheme (rules 23, 30).
